schema.title: Italy Extension
schema.description: Schema for the Italy country extension

countryExtensionVersion.description:
This key specifies the version to which the current extension schema adheres to, for forward compatibility.

Please note how the value of this key is independent from the top-level publiccodeYmlVersion one (see The Standard (core)). In such a way, the extensions schema versioning is independent both from the core version of the schema and from every other Country.

conforme.description: This section contains the keys for auto-declaring the compliance with the current legislation, with respect to the following sections. Not including these keys implies that the compliance is not known or not declared.

lineeGuidaDesign.description: If present and set to true, the software is compliant with the Italian accessibility laws (L. 4/2004), as further explained in the linee guida di design (Italian language).

modelloInteroperabilita.description:
If present and set to true, the software is compliant with the linee guida sull'interoperabilità.

Regulatory reference: Art. 73 del CAD (Italian language).

misureMinimeSicurezza.description: If present and set to true, the software is compliant with the Misure minime di sicurezza ICT per le Pubbliche amministrazioni (Italian language).

gdpr.description: If present and set to true, the software respects the GDPR.

spid.description: If present and set to true, the software interfaces with SPID - il Sistema Pubblico di Identità Digitale.

cie.description: If present and set to true, the software interfaces with the Italian electronic ID card (Carta d'Identità Elettronica).

anpr.description: If present and set to true, the software interfaces with ANPR.

pagopa.description: If present and set to true, the software interfaces with pagoPA.

io.description: If present and set to true, the software interfaces with IO app (https://io.italia.it)

codiceIPA.description: This key represents the administration code inside the Public Administration index (codice IPA).

deprecated.hint: Use 'supports' for compliance with national regulations and integration with national platforms, and 'organisation' to reference the publishing administration.

Use 'organisation.uri' and set it to 'urn:x-italian-pa:<codiceIPA>' instead.
